verdict.line: You lose if you slug it out after his E lands; you win if you force short burst trades and disengage before Ground Slam resets.

brief.thesis: Camille's kit is auto-attack dependent, and Malphite's E (Ground Slam, cooldown 7s) exists specifically to cripple attack speed, so any trade that turns into a standing fight favors him. The matchup lives or dies on whether you engage with Q (Precision Protocol) and E (Hookshot) as hit-and-run tools or get baited into contesting his Granite Shield passive head-on.

theirWindow.when: He lands W or E on you
theirWindow.what: Once Brutal Strikes is active his armor and AD spike, and once Ground Slam has hit you your attack speed is reduced for its duration — disengage immediately rather than trying to out-auto him through it.

yourWindow.what: Chain Q's empowered auto and W (Tactical Sweep) into the knockup window before his Granite Shield passive recharges, then walk away — don't linger for a second rotation.

start.why: Runs at 51% WR over 972 games and absorbs his Q (Seismic Shard) poke so you aren't ground down before you can look for a hit-and-run trade.

boots.why: His whole kit (Q, E, R) deals magic damage, and Treads sit at 51.9% WR over 983 games — the resistances matter more than the slow-resist here since he has no hard CC to tenacity through besides the R knockup.

core.why: The move speed and damage spike turns Q+auto trades into real burst instead of a prolonged fight you'll lose to his E attack-speed cut.
Sustain through poke and cleave on his Granite Shield-absorbed trades; this path runs 57.2% WR over 306 games.
Keeps you alive through his W-buffed autos and R engage so a bad trade doesn't end the fight outright.

situational.when: the game goes long and you need R up more often to pick him off his team rather than duel him
he's ahead on solo kills and you need a damage-reduction buffer to survive his burst
their team has stacked up heavy auto-attack damage alongside Malphite and Treads' MR isn't enough

runes.keystoneWhy: Procs on your auto-attack-reliant trades for sustained health against his poke, and this page runs 52.9% WR over the sample — Bone Plating specifically blunts his Q-into-E burst combo.

summoners.why: Highest-performing combo at 51.1% WR and 53.9% pick rate — since solo-kill advantage favors Malphite, Ignite lets you convert the trades you do win into a kill instead of a reset.

playing.title: Bait Granite Shield before engaging
playing.detail: Malphite's passive absorbs damage and recharges if he hasn't been hit recently — poke it down with a ranged Q or W cast before committing your full combo.

playing.title: Hit-and-run, never slug
playing.detail: Once his E (Ground Slam) lands your attack speed is reduced — disengage the moment it hits rather than trying to trade through the duration.

playing.title: Delay your Q recast
playing.detail: Precision Protocol's recast deals significantly more bonus damage the longer you wait between the two attacks — use the delayed version in planned trades, not instant double-taps.

playing.title: Only E in for a full combo
playing.detail: Hookshot is on a 16-12s cooldown and needs a wall — don't throw it just to close distance, save it for a trade you can follow with Q and W.

playing.title: Back off when he activates W
playing.detail: Brutal Strikes spikes his armor and AD and hits everyone in front of him — contesting it head-on is a losing trade for you.

playing.title: Use R to isolate, not to duel
playing.detail: The Hextech Ultimatum is best spent catching him off his team or overextended, since his kit still deals real magic damage in a straight 1v1.

playing.title: Respect his Q range before level 3
playing.detail: Seismic Shard outranges your pre-E engage options and slows you — don't walk into 625-range poke before Hookshot is up.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, boots, and summoner picks above are the measured highest-performing choices from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the trade-timing and engage reads are my own tactical analysis layered on top of the ability text.

stats.opponentTip: Malphite’s (E) slows your attack speed, making it difficult to engage evenly. Use Camille’s [P] and Hookshot[E] to hit and run.
